# PhotoEditingPrompt

> Free, copy-and-paste photo editing prompts for ChatGPT and Gemini. Each prompt keeps your real face and comes with a sample result image. Written by us; not copied from other sites.

## Main collections
- [Couple prompts](https://photoeditingprompt.com/couple-photo-prompts/)
- [1980s photo prompts](https://photoeditingprompt.com/1980s-photo-prompts/)
- [Photo prompts for boys](https://photoeditingprompt.com/photo-prompts-for-boys/)
- [Photo prompts for girls](https://photoeditingprompt.com/photo-prompts-for-girls/)
- [Family and group photo prompts](https://photoeditingprompt.com/family-group-photo-prompts/)
- [Festival prompts](https://photoeditingprompt.com/festivals/)

## How to use
Open ChatGPT or Gemini, upload a clear front-facing photo, paste the prompt, send.
